# Politeness padding (LEX008)

Filler politeness adds tokens and no constraint.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Rule ID | `lex-politeness-padding` |
| Family | lexical |
| Applies to | `core` |
| Default severity | `suggestion` |
| Fix | `auto` |
| Evidence | prac |
| Sniffers | vale, llm |
| Contextual evaluation | LLM |

Softeners aimed at a model carry no instruction and cost tokens. Drop them; state the task.

Bad:  I was wondering if you could please validate the token.
Good: Validate the token.

Not a finding inside a quoted example or code block.

## Detector metadata

```yaml
- kind: vale
  pattern: \b(I'?d (really )?appreciate|if you could,? please|would you mind|I was
    wondering if|it would be great if|if it'?s not too much trouble|please kindly)\b
  confidence: high
  hook_safe: false
- kind: llm
  confidence: medium
  hook_safe: false
```
